caption:
Your losses aren't spread across the day. They're stacked in one window — and most traders have never looked.

It isn't that the market gets harder. It's that you get different: fatigue, the need to make the day count, the drift after a loss. All of them land at roughly the same time, every day. Split your results by hour and the same method looks like two different traders.

Most people change the strategy instead. No rebuild touches a problem that lives in the clock.

Comment "LINE" for the checklist on reading your own session.
